phases.objective: Restore GitHub planning and registration across the PR refresh, Work Map Recovery, and Work Map Integration chain by initializing runner-scoped paths only after runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow planner and governed Work Map operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Authorized same-repository pull request changing a registered Work Map or generated-artifact path
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The PR workflow registers, validates the exact current head, delegates to Recovery, and makes Integration evidence paths available without evaluating runner.temp before runner allocation.
steps: Plan PR Generated Artifact Refresh without job-level runner.temp.
Allocate a runner and publish absolute refresh and activation report paths through GITHUB_ENV.
Validate the open same-repository pull request, exact head SHA, authorization marker, and behind_by=0.
Dispatch the Recovery workflow after its bounded report directory is initialized from RUNNER_TEMP.
Consume the one-time marker only inside Recovery and delegate to the sole Work Map writer.
Run Work Map Integration with its repair root initialized after runner allocation.
Upload canonical secret-free evidence from the initialized paths.
assertions: No workflow in the repaired chain evaluates runner.temp in job-level env.
PR evaluation and Integration retain contents: read and no git push authority.
Recovery preserves exact-head validation, one-time marker consumption, and sole-writer delegation.
All paths are derived from RUNNER_TEMP only after the runner is allocated.
No Production, provider, deployment, database, SQL, Migration Apply, credential, protected-ref, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve existing exact-head validation, read-only evaluation, workflow activation readback, Recovery authorization consumption, writer dispatch, Integration repair-candidate publication, and bounded Artifacts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static workflow contracts and focused executable regressions
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repaired chain retains the original authority split: read-only PR evaluation and Integration, one-time authorization consumption in Recovery, and remote content mutation only in the sole writer.
steps: Inspect the permissions and triggers of the three repaired workflows.
Require exact-head and zero-behind validation before Recovery delegation.
Require one-time marker consumption only in Recovery.
Require PR evaluation and Integration to remain free of contents: write and git push.
Require bounded report and repair paths to be published through GITHUB_ENV after allocation.
assertions: The PR workflow and Integration remain repository read-only.
Recovery dispatches the existing sole writer and does not implement a duplicate writer.
Protected branch mutation and force push remain false in structured evidence.
No secrets are included in reports or Artifacts.

phases.objective: Fail regression if runner.temp returns to pre-allocation evaluation or any required report-path initialization bridge is removed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Candidate change to any repaired workflow or Work Map governance test
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact-head gate rejects pre-allocation runner context use, missing initialization bridges, widened write authority, or unbounded report paths before merge.
steps: Load each repaired workflow as trusted text.
Reject any runner.temp expression in the repaired chain.
Require the named post-allocation initialization step and RUNNER_TEMP path for each job.
Require GITHUB_ENV publication and matching Artifact paths.
Run E2E reference integrity and repository lifecycle governance on the bounded changed scope.
assertions: The regression fails before delegation if a runner-scoped path is evaluated too early.
The regression fails if read-only jobs gain contents: write or git push.
No temporary unregistered repository tool is introduced.
All implemented phases expose at least one complete E2E journey.

phases.objective: This repository workflow-registration repair has no provider canary authority.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
